subject: BENCHMITTENS
name: Mittens V4: cat and person portrait

styleSelection.reason: The high-key portrait is carried by light warm value planes and dry, fitted facial landmarks; line work stays selective.

mittens.hair.reason: The dark, irregular curl silhouette needs connected mixed-dark paint and a few directional lines rather than a smooth dark fill.

families.referenceCue: The cat's pale muzzle and soft orange cheek and ear markings fade into the white paper; reserve the eye, nose shine, and whisker gaps.
The person's dark loose curls make an irregular crown against the pale forehead and paper.
The face is a pale warm plane with crisp brows, eyes, nose and mouth, and only a light cheek and jaw turn.

reserves.reason: Bare-paper catchlight in the cat's visible eye; keep the surrounding iris painted, not white.
Bare-paper catchlight in the person's left eye.
Bare-paper catchlight in the person's right eye.
A narrow pale plane on the bridge of the person's nose; leave the wash luminous, then tone any overly white edge with a light local glaze only if needed.
